button.label: Open MathBlocks
button.screentip: Open the MathBlocks editor. In a document: Ctrl+Alt+M edits the equation at the cursor (or starts a new one) in the floating editor.

button.label: Insert test equation
button.screentip: Insert a sample equation without the app (connector self-test)

toggleButton.label: Show linked equations
toggleButton.screentip: Frame equations that are linked to your MathBlocks library

button.label: Connection status
button.screentip: Show whether Word is connected to the MathBlocks app

button.label: Number equation
button.screentip: Give the selected MathBlocks equation a number (or remove it)

button.label: Insert reference
button.screentip: Insert a reference to a numbered equation at the cursor

button.label: Update numbers
button.screentip: Renumber equations and update references to them

button.label: List of symbols
button.screentip: Insert or update a list of symbols (nomenclature) made from this document's equations; descriptions you type in it are kept

button.label: Convert MathType equations
button.screentip: Turn this document's MathType equations into native, editable MathBlocks equations (one undo step)

button.label: Convert LaTeX
button.screentip: Turn LaTeX written in the text ($…$, $$…$$, \(…\), \[…\]) into MathBlocks equations: the selection when there is one, otherwise the whole document (one undo step). Ctrl+Alt+L converts just the one at the cursor.

button.label: Repair equations
button.screentip: Give every MathBlocks equation its own wrapper again: splits wrappers holding several equations or text, gives copies their own ID, re-wraps pasted pictures and puts floating ones back in line (one undo step, backup).
